title: Book 2: Live in Chicago & Mile Marker 98 (1990)
description: From the sold-out October 12, 1990 triumph at the Rosemont Horizon to the blinding snow of December 10, 1990 at Mile Marker 98 outside Des Moines, Iowa—where Ryan O'Connell survives a complete T10 spinal cord injury and the family builds Protocol T-10.
